statement: Run a script file of command-line input, one command per line, spaces equal Enter, blank line equals Enter, with comments by semicolon.
superiority: Scripts run in a sandbox with step-through and dry-run.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers RunScript, LoadScript; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Script containing LINE 0,0 10,0 (blank line) creates a line; semicolon comment ignored; filename in SCRIPT prompt.

statement: Repeat the current script from the start; RESUME continues an interrupted script; Esc cancels; DELAY waits in milliseconds.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: RSCRIPT loops endlessly until Esc; DELAY 1000 waits about 1 second; RESUME resumes after pause.

statement: Use dialogless -commands with FILEDIA 0 and CMDECHO 0 in scripts.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Script uses -LAYER and -INSERT without dialogs; FILEDIA reset at end.

statement: Run a script at startup from command line: acad.exe /b file.scr, with /nologo and /product, headless core console /s.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: accoreconsole /i dwg /s file.scr produces the same DWG as GUI run.

statement: Loop over files using a driver (SCRIPT with OPEN and QSAVE, CLOSE) or a batch utility.

source.ref: Batch processing of many drawings with scripts
source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/ (topic: Batch processing of many drawings with scripts)

notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Script opens 5 files, runs PURGE, saves and closes; all 5 files modified time updated.

statement: An invalid command line pauses or stops scripts, and bad input is passed to the current prompt; scripts end with a final blank line.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Bad coordinate string causes script to stop with message at the offending line.

statement: Embed LISP expressions in scripts: lines beginning with ( are evaluated.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Lisp; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Script line (setq a 5) then CIRCLE 0,0 !a evaluates a.

statement: Record actions and save as macro (.actm) or script via RECSCRIPT/ RECSTOP (older).
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers RecordMacro; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: RECSCRIPT records typed commands to a file; RECSTOP ends.

statement: Use -PLOT in scripts, with PUBLISH from DSD file and Batch Plot.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Script prints to PDF named file.

statement: Scripts run from trusted paths; startup scripts respect SECURELOAD.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Script outside trusted path flagged.
